title: /bug should not exit
body:
It's called /bug not /bug_out_on_me, the user expects that it reports bug, not that it closes the app.

Claude discarded half of my file's source code in trying to make an edit so I reported it (7b472232-3dd1-4d6a-8c25-012544d59f80 ) and I get rewarded with losing my session.

edit: it is displayed sth like "press any key to exit" but apparently pressing Escape still avoid the exit. My remark still applies though.
author: tassa-yoniso-manasi-karoto
